changes: Highground adds independent feature guides with saved progress, sample actions and addon artwork. Back/Forward keeps drafts and filters across supported windows.
Bounties add wanted posters, community boards, tracked sightings, rewards per kill, added gold, account balances and offline import/export. Claims and payments still need player review.
Reputation shares reports and moderator decisions within existing guilds and WoW communities, with optional chat filtering. Highground: `/hg reputation`. Standalone Reputation: `/hgrep`.
Arena now handles duels with a stable opponent. Arena, carrier and Nearby rows gain larger icons and clearer layouts; HUD backgrounds can fade while idle.
Macros gains Back/Forward navigation and returns from review dialogs without losing the current draft.
notice: Restart WoW after updating; install every folder in each ZIP, including HighgroundReputationData. Forever bounty lists now separate by ruleset: older unscoped lists stay saved but need review or recreation in the correct ruleset. CurseForge files may await moderation.
